cards_resequenced.change: The supplier invoice series work was marked finished overnight and it is not finished. The automated quality run on it came back failed, and the browser tests that were supposed to prove the feature works never ran at all, in either of the two attempts. Nothing is wrong with the work itself as far as anyone can tell; it is simply unproven. It stays open until the tests have actually run and passed, and it must not be approved before then, because approving it is what writes the change into the live database.

The credential lockdown item now carries one more tick-box and the reason for it. After that lockdown runs, every piece of work waiting in the queue comes back to you for approval one by one, and there are forty-five of them. The box makes somebody count them and tell you the number before anything is switched off, rather than you discovering it the following morning.

escalations.title: The extraction supplier needs to be told that supplier invoices now have a second field, the letter code printed before the invoice number. Until he sends it, the system will keep storing it as blank and the work done overnight buys nothing.
escalations.recommendation: Tell him, in the same message as the live document test you already owe him, that supplier documents should now be sent with the series letters and the number as two separate values rather than one. RECOMMENDED BECAUSE IT COSTS ONE SENTENCE AND THE ALTERNATIVE IS A FEATURE THAT SILENTLY DOES NOTHING: our side already accepts documents with or without it, so nothing breaks either way and there is no deadline pressure on him. THE REASON IT NEEDS YOU: nobody here writes to him directly, by standing rule. IF UNANSWERED: the field ships, stays permanently empty, and two different suppliers issuing the same invoice number keep looking like the same document to the system, which is the exact problem this was meant to fix.

escalations.title: Two settings in the live hosting environment for the low-stock warning email have been recorded as missing since 2026-08-26 and are still not confirmed set. This is the fifth time it has been raised and the first was seven days ago.
escalations.recommendation: Set RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_FROM in the production environment, by name only, and reply that they are set. RECOMMENDED BECAUSE THEY COST NOTHING AND ARE ON THE CRITICAL PATH ANYWAY: both are already required items on the credential lockdown checklist, so doing them now removes two items from that day rather than adding any. THE HONEST CAVEAT, UNCHANGED: this does NOT make the readiness condition pass on its own. The warning email is currently addressed to an account on a domain that does not exist, so even with both settings in place it would be sent to nobody, and that third piece lands with the real staff accounts at the lockdown. IF UNANSWERED: nothing breaks. The warning email keeps recording its reason on screen and not sending, which is the designed behaviour, and both settings simply wait to be done on lockdown day instead.
